Anisodactyl_Raptorial_Talons.description: Heavily scaled legs terminating in four toes (three forward, one backward), each armed with an immense, scythe-like talon. They lock via specialized tendons into a vice-grip capable of crushing a prey's windpipe instantly upon impact.

Cursorial_Ratite_Legs.description: Thick, towering, two-toed legs packed with astonishingly dense muscle. Entirely incapable of grasping, they are built exclusively to propel the entity at terrifying terrestrial speeds and deliver bone-shattering forward kicks.
